question: 不同年龄段用户的客单价分布情况
gold_sql:
select case
  when u.age between 18 and 25 then '18-25岁'
  when u.age between 26 and 35 then '26-35岁'
  when u.age between 36 and 45 then '36-45岁'
  when u.age between 46 and 60 then '46-60岁'
  else '60岁以上'
end as age_bucket,
  sum(o.total_amount) / count(distinct o.order_id) as avg_order_value
from orders o left join users u on o.user_id = u.user_id
where o.status = '已完成'
group by age_bucket
order by age_bucket
raw_output:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN u.age < 18 THEN '18岁以下'
    WHEN u.age BETWEEN 18 AND 25 THEN '18-25岁'
    WHEN u.age BETWEEN 26 AND 35 THEN '26-35岁'
    WHEN u.age BETWEEN 36 AND 45 THEN '36-45岁'
    WHEN u.age BETWEEN 46 AND 55 THEN '46-55岁'
    WHEN u.age >= 56 THEN '56岁以上'
    ELSE '未知'
  END AS age_group,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.user_id) AS customer_count,
  SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_sales,
  ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT o.user_id), 2) AS avg_customer_value
FROM orders o
JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.user_id
WHERE o.status = '已完成'
GROUP BY age_group
ORDER BY age_group;
